primary_sources.title: CUDA C++ Programming Guide 12.9.1
primary_sources.use: Warp vote/match/shuffle contracts; Volta independent thread scheduling; match_any supports sm_70+, reduce_sync needs sm_80+; WMMA collective constraints.

primary_sources.title: PTX ISA 8.8
primary_sources.use: lop3.b32 implements a ternary Boolean lookup with an instruction-immediate truth table; shf is a funnel shift. Fixed primitives are not pre-discovered genomic biology.

primary_sources.title: Using CUDA Warp-Level Primitives
primary_sources.use: Explicit participant masks, warp-local collectives and Volta-safe synchronization.

primary_sources.title: Register Cache: Caching for Warp-Centric CUDA Programs
primary_sources.use: Shuffle-based register exchange is prior art; register pressure and spills can negate benefits. This does not establish a free arbitrary dynamic register array.

primary_sources.title: Optimized Filtering with Warp-Aggregated Atomics
primary_sources.use: Ballot/rank and leader reservation are established; compilers can aggregate atomics already. Stable and unordered selection have different contracts.

primary_sources.title: CUDA Toolkit 13.0 release notes
primary_sources.use: Offline compilation and library support for Volta removed in CUDA 13; use the recorded 12.9 toolchain, not latest by default.

primary_sources.title: CUB WarpScan
primary_sources.use: Library scan baseline; use the CUB shipped with CUDA 12.9, not unpinned latest CCCL.

primary_sources.title: CUTLASS: Fast Linear Algebra in CUDA C++
primary_sources.use: Volta WMMA and hierarchical tiling exist; no justification to force tiny ragged operators onto Tensor Cores before measurement.

primary_sources.title: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
primary_sources.use: Learned content/context-dependent hierarchical chunking, including DNA experiments, already exists. Do not claim dynamic hierarchy itself as novel.

primary_sources.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
primary_sources.use: Input-dependent state propagation with hardware-aware recurrent computation is established. Affine/selective scan is an algorithmic reference, not a Baseplane invention.

primary_sources.title: Mixture-of-Depths
primary_sources.use: Content-dependent allocation of computation under a bounded budget; selection quality and routing overhead matter.

primary_sources.title: MegaBlocks: Efficient Sparse Training with Mixture-of-Experts
primary_sources.use: Packing variable routed work without discarding tokens motivates a conditional tile-batching extension; no training framework is copied into Baseplane.

repository_sources.finding: sm_70/CUDA12.9 invariant; frozen sequence event/predicate interfaces; legacy non-goals/ownership more restrictive than current user intent; no active run observed; stale legacy dependency warnings.
Standalone Baseplane::seq C++17/CUDA; warp bit-plane conversion is a proof path; historical 0.325ms run was count-only, not dense embedding throughput; preserve caller-owned buffers and exact APIs.
Native schema-v2, parent_id, local dependencies, command/CUDA gates and evaluated_not_promoted disposition.
